sections.text: Introduction to Capacity Connect prototype landing page and logging into the Admin Course Approval Dashboard, demonstrating how course approvals and global announcements work.
Exploring the Platform Analytics dashboard including trainer stats, course metrics, credit distribution, popular courses, trainer search by subject, and admin profile settings.
Logging in as a Trainer to create a new course, setting up course details, pricing via Capacity Credits, uploading video lectures and document resources, and submitting for approval.
Admin reviews and approves the pending DBMS course, posts a platform-wide announcement, followed by reviewing trainer analytics, contribution credits, and subject competencies.
Trainee signup and onboarding into the Learner Workspace, browsing courses, enrolling, reviewing module materials, completing lectures, and receiving verified course certificates.
Reviewing Capacity Credits wallet transactions, achievements, monthly leaderboard rankings, trainee profile customization, and the upcoming AI Doubt Solver assistant.

clips.title: Monetizing Courses with Capacity Credits
clips.hook: If you want to keep this course as a paid course, here is how the credit system works.
clips.caption: Learn how educators can monetize their training modules using Capacity Credits on Capacity Connect! 💡🎓 #EdTech #CourseCreation #OnlineLearning #Elearning
clips.reason: Clear, concise demonstration of a core platform differentiator: gating content behind customizable credit values.

clips.title: Trainer Analytics and Competency Matching
clips.hook: Admins can automatically match the right trainers to courses based on validated subject competencies.
clips.caption: Tracking engagement and matching subject experts made seamless with Capacity Connect's trainer portal. 📊🚀 #Analytics #CorporateTraining #TrainerPortal #LMS
clips.reason: Highlights the two-sided value proposition for instructors and organizations managing internal knowledge transfer.

clips.title: Course Completion to Verified Certificate
clips.hook: Finish your course, submit your feedback, and get an instantly verified digital certificate.
clips.caption: From learning to certification in seconds! Watch the student experience and instant verification in action. 📜✅ #Certification #SkillBuilding #ContinuousLearning
clips.reason: High-reward moment showcasing immediate student gratification: rating submission, credential issuance, and verification modal.

clips.title: Gamified Learning with Credit Passbooks
clips.hook: Every course you complete deposits Capacity Credits right into your digital wallet.
clips.caption: Gamifying professional upskilling with redeemable credits and live monthly leaderboards! 🏆🪙 #Gamification #IncentivizedLearning #EdTechDemo
clips.reason: Demonstrates the gamified incentive loop (earning, spending, and ranking on the leaderboard) which drives user retention.
